review_scope: Independent source-contract and visual review of the olive family only: eight fitted heroes, four 100 m detailed originals, four 1 km lowest originals, both-LOD 100 m / 1 km pixel magnifications, and the existing lemon/avocado 100 m originals and magnifications. All 48 olive frame bindings and all 24 LOD pairs were checked. No models, sources, exports, previews, Unreal, Content, maps, bank, Houdini or git were changed.
basis: Source generator and fresh source-readback receipt inspected and bound to the current Blend and textures. FBX files hashed for exact identification; fresh FBX-import QA is the root validator responsibility and is not claimed as performed by this review.

source_contract.texture_contract: BaseColor sRGB; Normal OpenGL +Y; ORM R=AO G=roughness B=metallic, both Non-Color. No alpha masks, wind or collision.
source_contract.export_contract: Metres, scale_length=1; FBX -Y forward, Z up, applied unit scale; eight separate mesh FBXs.
source_contract.construction: Each detailed tree has 18 recessed closed crown clumps and 7,200 closed narrow bowed leaf volumes with separate pale underside faces. Each authored lowest tree retains 18 rounded crown clumps, the split trunk and supporting limbs. No billboard.

close_visual_observations: All four detailed trees show grey-green fine leaf geometry with paler faces, open gaps between crown clumps, and twisted/split trunks; no floating roots, inverted orientation or visibly wrong scale was found.
A/B/C have related but different irregular crown silhouettes and the requested 4.5/5.5/6.5 m heights; Young is distinctly smaller at 2 m.

Lowest heroes intentionally expose smooth closed proxy clumps at close range. Their crown distribution and trunk are retained; use these meshes for far views. The family has a visible procedural, stylized character rather than close-up botanical photorealism.

distance_evidence.settings_summary: Cycles, 1920x1080, horizontal 60-degree FOV, Standard view, exposure0, fixed lighting, no denoise. Original images retain actual screen size; magnifications are nearest-neighbour diagnostic crops.
distance_evidence.combined_report_status_note: Overall suite may be partial because grass work is separate. This decision is scoped to the complete stable olive/reference subset.

at_100_m_comparison.conclusion: The detailed olive is less saturated and more open than the delivered lemon and avocado examples at the same camera distance/FOV/light and their actual sizes. The larger visible crown gaps and split trunk distinguish it from the compact citrus crowns; close heroes establish the fine lanceolate foliage. Fine species anatomy is not individually resolved at this distance.
at_100_m_comparison.method: Same 100 m camera/FOV/light; actual model scale; alpha-weighted upper-crown screen-region proxy. Saturation of mean RGB is descriptive, not species recognition.

far_visual_conclusion: At 1 km, mature A/B/C remain full crown-and-trunk silhouettes with no disappearance or pale material drift in the reviewed Blender view. Lowest coverage is 109-113 percent of detailed, with silhouette IoU 0.849-0.893. Young remains present but is below robust species/shape identification resolution.

limits_and_native_actions.observation: Young at 1 km occupies only about 3.76 equivalent opaque pixels and a 4x3 pixel low-LOD box; its detailed box is 4x4. The low image is about 9.76 sRGB luma code values brighter than detailed, while mature differences are about 1.51-3.08. This is a very small, partially covered raster sample; no disappearance occurred.
limits_and_native_actions.action: Keep its correct 2 m scale and explicitly report this limit. Verify it in the native distant grove under actual antialiasing/background conditions; do not promise individually recognizable olive anatomy at 1 km.

limits_and_native_actions.observation: These are offline Blender renders and source-contract checks. They do not demonstrate Unreal import, Nanite, streaming, native material fidelity, saved/reopened maps, runtime performance or Instancing HLOD behavior.
limits_and_native_actions.action: After the separate native authorization, explicitly assign each *_LOD3.fbx as the corresponding tree lowest LOD. The filename alone does not create an LOD chain. Preserve all four material slots including unused leaf slots, apply opaque/two-sided foliage and the documented texture color spaces, and verify no-cull always-loaded HLOD behavior using the actual scene.

limits_and_native_actions.observation: The lowest clumps look smooth and rounded in fitted close views. Mature fixed 5 m images can crop the crown because their camera distance is literal.
limits_and_native_actions.action: Use the detailed mesh for close views and the fitted heroes for whole-tree close inspection; compare lowest shape at the intended far distances.

hash_capture: Hashes captured during this independent review and rechecked immediately before writing this receipt. They are not a claim of capture before the earlier hero renders. Frame sidecars separately contain their measured pre-render source/texture bindings.
excluded_from_readiness: Whole-delivery completion, grass/vine acceptance, native editor work and root fresh-FBX validation.
